1: In the scope of the paper on multi-criteria decision making and limited data on the problem, we used MS excel 2016 to calculate the model. And Our paper can be accepted for publication with a request to submit the code to Code Ocean. However CodeOCean does not support submission for MS Excel 2016-based computed models. So we have to write a python script to read the Excel results and write them into the results folder. All calculations of the proposed model have been completed in Excel files: 
2: Language_Variable.xlsx ---> Complex Neutrosophic Language Variable
3: - The weights of the criteria are calculated at files
4: (1) Environment.xlsx
5: (2) Quality.xlsx
6: (3) Service.xlsx
7: (4) Group_Environment.xlsx
8: (5) Group_Quality.xlsx
9: (6) Group_Service.xlsx
10: (7) Goal.xlsx ---> final weights of criteria
11: - TCNS-ANP-TOPSIS for tourist destination choice problems:
12: TCNS_ANP_TOPSIS.xlsx 
13: 
14: script.py ---> read and write results to the results folder.
15: 
16: We can see that the model can be computed fully in Excel, which means that it is easy to use and can be converted to any language code easily.
17: 
18: Please take a have a look on our calculations and comments, as well as give us a confirmation if possible so we can finalize the paper.
19: 
20: Sincerely,
21: The authors
